title: Gym Media Plan: 1-Page Take-Home Assignment
story: As part of an agency interview, you are asked to draft a 1-page media plan for a new gym branch in Whitefield, Bengaluru with a ₹45,000 launch budget over 30 days.

steps.prompt: How should you divide the ₹1,500 daily budget across ad sets?
options: Run 2 consolidated ad sets: Ad Set 1 (Broad 21-45, 6km radius) at ₹1,000/day, and Ad Set 2 (Fitness & Gym interests) at ₹500/day
Put all ₹1,500 into a Brand Awareness post
Spend the entire ₹45,000 in the first 48 hours
steps.explain: Consolidating budget into 2 robust ad sets ensures each set generates 3-5 leads daily to exit the learning phase smoothly.

steps.prompt: What 3 creative variations should you prepare for the launch?
options: 3 identical photos with different background colors
Variant A: Real member transformation video; Variant B: Fast-paced gym facility tour Reel; Variant C: Carousel of trainer credentials and equipment
Stock photos of bodybuilders from foreign countries
steps.explain: Testing 3 distinct angles (social proof, facility tour, trainer expertise) helps identify which psychological trigger hooks local members.

finalQuestion: Write a 3-bullet summary describing your review and optimization schedule across the 30-day campaign.
keyPoints: Day 1-2: Confirm delivery and spend pacing without touching settings
Day 3-5: Evaluate CTR and CPL across creatives, pausing low performers
Weekly: Refresh creatives and increase budget 15-20% on winning ad sets
modelAnswer:
• Days 1-2: Audit delivery pacing, ensure pixel and CRM lead notifications trigger within 60 seconds without altering settings.
• Days 3-5: Evaluate Outbound CTR and cost per trial pass; pause creatives with CTR under 1.0% and reallocate spend to the top transformation Reel.
• Days 7-30: Scale winning ad sets by 15-20% weekly while monitoring lead show-up rates with the gym front desk.
